chunks: Muhammad b. Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Aziz b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Mu'adh narrated to me. He said: Sulayman b. Dawud narrated to us. He said: Al-Hakam b. Thahir narrated to us from al-Suddi from Abu Malik.
Regarding the saying of the Mighty and Majestic: "Peace be upon the Family of Yasin" [37:130], he said: Yasin is Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family.

key_terms.إل ياسين: The Family of Yasin - interpreted as the Family of Muhammad
key_terms.عز وجل: Mighty and Majestic - an honorific for God

ai.seo_question: Who is Yasin in the Quranic verse "Peace be upon the Family of Yasin" (37:130)?
ai.summary: This hadith provides a Quranic commentary on verse 37:130 ("Peace be upon the Family of Yasin"), identifying Yasin as the Prophet Muhammad (s). Transmitted through Abu Malik, this interpretation supports the Shia understanding that "Al Yasin" refers to the Prophet and his family (Ahl al-Bayt), connecting the Quranic greeting of peace specifically to the household of the Prophet.
